scope: current verified explicitly bound Plex source only

bounds.revision_fields: nonempty opaque equality tokens of at most256characters, no control characters; actual current registry binding revisions are canonical decimal safe integer strings

semantics: Prepare is additive; existing begin/append/preview/commit/status/abort/snapshot request and result shapes remain unchanged.

Capture prepareStart once and validate the authenticated envelope has not expired at actual dispatch, including after lazy load. wholeDeadline=prepareStart+budget_ms; queue expiry controls dispatch, not the separately explicit bounded operation budget. Later RPCs each require an unexpired dispatch envelope and never renew the whole deadline. TTL=min(10000,remainingWholeBudget); response repeats requested budget_ms and actual admission_ttl_ms.
Require actual current source/profile/runtime/binding/base revision, healthy physical store qualification and crypto randomness; prepare creates no persistent data.

At most one unconsumed grant and one active stage. Busy refuses without replacing an existing live grant or stage. A lost prepare ACK is not replayed automatically; unconsumed grant expires within10seconds.

Begin consumes exactly the minted operation_id plus scope/base/binding/document digest/size and captured trusted context. Internal commit reinspection may reuse ONLY the same transaction/runtime context. No receipt absence or eviction ever means fresh.
Grant expires on TTL, whole deadline or source/profile/runtime/binding drift. Abort/expiry/rejection before commit have no persistent writes.
After consumption the original whole deadline follows the stage through append/preview/commit. No per-request deadline extension.
Unknown/partial commit is reconciled by fresh same-scope read-only status and actual persisted target readback; no new prepare or mutation replay for that old operation.

retention.completed_eviction: Oldest proved verified/not_applied completion may be removed before24h under count or byte pressure.
retention.protected: Pending/partial/unknown are never evicted to admit another transfer.
retention.missing_or_expired_receipt: unknown; never freshness or mutation replay permission
retention.precommit: Planning, preview, abort, expiry and rejected begin have no durable receipt writes. Pending receipt is committed by exact prepared CAS immediately before first favorites write.

actual_runtime_requirements: Reachable authenticated executeRemoteRequest dispatch and asynchronous capability query load only a fixed internal optional asset.

Capability is reported only after read-only qualification of actual current verified PMS, complete TV/media/registry/receipt owners, physical compression codec and conditional writer; code loading is not storage initialization.
Preserve exact physical bytes for CAS/hash and decode existing provider compression for logical cache comparisons/adoption.
Private local selectors, owner tokens, credentials, URLs, grants and raw store documents never enter wire responses.
PIN/kiosk/parental policy and actual envelope deadline remain enforced; late asset load/cancellation cannot dispatch writes.
limits_note: Limits intersect. Persistent readback is not cross-tab, filesystem-fsync or cross-store atomicity. No deployed capability/route is claimed until actual runtime integration and tests pass.
